dtm.title: 2025年版全臺灣20公尺網格數值地形模型DTM資料
dtm.status: Official file downloaded and verified locally; loopback API samples camera extent on demand
dtm.limitations: Camera view shows sampled elevation points, not a true terrain mesh. Original grid covers Taiwan main island and has differing source production years; not a survey-grade engineering conclusion. Large raster is ignored by Git and must be installed on each machine.

buildings3d.status: Official service list GET 200 with 35 building services from loopback runtime using Windows system CA; Yilan tileset root GET 200, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; browser added Yilan tileset layer
buildings3d.limitations: HEAD returns 405 and must not be used as a load check. Root retrieval alone does not confirm that all child tiles render. Models are online visualization tiles, not a downloadable national building-count vector.

nationalReferenceMap.status: GetMap for a Yilan 256 x 256 tile returned HTTP 200 image/png
nationalReferenceMap.limitations: National WMS imagery is a visual reference. Independent OSM vectors are still fetched by current view and subject to Overpass availability and load limits.
